ابتدها (form VIII)
# اِبْتَدَهَا (ibtadahā) /ib.ta.da.haː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِبْتَدَهَ (ibtadaha)
# اُبْتُدِهَا (ubtudihā) /ub.tu.di.haː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِبْتَدَهَ (ibtadaha)
# اِبْتَدِهَا (ibtadihā) /ib.ta.di.haː/: second-person dual imperative of اِبْتَدَهَ (ibtadaha)
